Kurzbeschreibung: Core communication skills for personal health coaching.
Ausführliche Beschreibung: This programme strengthens conversational practice for Personal Health Coaching. Participants rehearse goal clarification, reflective listening and collaborative action planning. Case discussions include stress regulation in everyday coaching encounters. The course builds professional communication without framing medical diagnoses as directory categories.

Vollständiger Titel: EasyBits™ – Stress Regulation in Daily Life
Kurzbeschreibung: Practical training for modulating tension and stress.
Ausführliche Beschreibung: EasyBits™ teaches short practices for recognising and modulating stress regulation in daily routines. Online live sessions combine breath, attention and gentle movement. Participants apply the methods to work and personal situations. Depression is discussed only as a topic that may appear in coaching conversations, not as a primary directory category.

Kurzbeschreibung: Behaviour change foundations for lifestyle-oriented coaching.
Ausführliche Beschreibung: Coaches explore nutrition, movement, sleep and connection as levers of lifestyle medicine practice. Secondary topics include Type 2 Diabetes and hypertension as contexts that members may search for while remaining outside the primary taxonomy. The emphasis stays on coaching domains of Personal Health Coaching and health promotion.
Weitere Kategorien: Type 2 Diabetes, hypertension, Prevention & Health Promotion

Ausführliche Beschreibung: This course prepares coaches to accompany women through the menopause transition with clarity and respect. Content covers sleep disruption, mood changes and workplace strain as coaching themes. Menopause remains searchable in course content while Women's Health is the primary discovery domain.

Kurzbeschreibung: Practical coaching skills focused on men's health contexts.
Ausführliche Beschreibung: Participants practise coaching conversations that often arise in men's health settings, including recovery after overload and sustainable movement habits. Hypertension may appear as a searchable secondary theme. The primary category remains Men's Health within the PHC taxonomy.

Vollständiger Titel: Falls Prevention Coaching for Older Adults
Kurzbeschreibung: Coaching approaches that support confidence and mobility with age.
Ausführliche Beschreibung: This CPD offering equips coaches to support healthy ageing with practical falls prevention conversations. Strength, balance and home routines are explored as coaching topics. Falls prevention is searchable content; Healthy Ageing is the primary taxonomy category.
